newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian coffee temperature and rain detailed.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian coffee temperature and rain detailed.

text.p: Brazilian coffee region temperatures (centigrade) and rain (millimeters) in the 24 hours to 1100 GMT.

Sao Paulo State: Presidente Prudente 20.8, 8.2 mm, Franca 18.6, 21.6 mm, Votuporanga 21.5, 1.0 mm, Catanduva 18.6, 14.3 mm, Sao Carlos 17.9, 2.1 mm, Simao 18.3, 38.2 mm.
Minas Gerais State: Pocos de Caldas 18.0, Nil, Guaxupe 16.8, Nil.
